drafter.rationale_plain: Location is confirmed: GPS medoid sits 5m from the property and house number 16812 appears in several photos. Before photos (5485fc39, bd1a1d46) show tall, weedy grass at front and side yards; After photos of the same areas (22d16a05, 4e54b99c, f7b73118) show cut, striped, edged lawn including rear yard, behind the garage, under the deck, and fence lines. However, the After set shows staging signs: a 46-second before/after gap on Front Lawn, and 27 photos across many stations taken within about a minute. Two photos (65239f73, 25819c44) are GPS outliers; one shows an entirely different building, likely misfiled. The audit's tree-on-roof defect relies on that mismatched photo.
drafter.notes_for_human: Payment evidence is time-staged: a 46-second before/after gap on Front Lawn and a ~67-second burst covering 27 After/Condition photos across many stations. Two photos (65239f73, 25819c44) are GPS outliers — one depicts a completely different building — and appear to be misfiled/reused rather than genuine site photos; they inflate the reported time-on-site metric. Despite this, the location-verified photos (GPS medoid 5m from property, house number visible) show clear before/after grass transformation across all sides, fence lines, and rear areas. Please confirm the staged timestamps don't indicate broader fabrication before releasing payment.

Before shots (ecf8fa98, 9918b82c, bd1a1d46) show overgrown, weedy grass; the After shots show the front (4e54b99c), both sides (8984a267, 89c5156c) and rear (1604db66, f7b73118, ff9961e3) mowed and edged, so all four sides were cut and there is a clear difference.
